features.name: counterargument_comment_count
features.definition: How many counter-argument comments by other users are in the list?
features.spec: import json; parse df['OC_comments'] as a JSON list; return len(list). Missing or malformed input gives null; an empty list gives 0.

h0: Counterargument comment count is not associated with the frequency of OP attribution replies.
h1: Posts with a single highly-rated counterargument have a higher frequency of OP attribution replies.
note: Unsupported. The claim needs (1) a per-comment rating, and none is supplied: post_score is the score of the OP's post, not of a comment. It also needs (2) the frequency of OP attribution replies as the outcome. The only outcome is delta, and OP replies are not available separately. conversation overlaps OC_comments, has unknown reply timing, and may include view-change announcements. I did not substitute a proxy. counterargument_comment_count only captures "single comment" and is not a test of the claim, so term=null.
